component.name: Atilgan
component.summary: A modern, lightweight file manager built with Go and GTK4

description.p: Atilgan is a fast, lightweight, and modern file manager for Linux, meticulously crafted using the Go programming language and the GTK4 toolkit. It offers a clean and intuitive interface that focuses on providing a seamless file navigation experience without unnecessary bloat.

ul.li: Efficient file and directory browsing with a responsive list view
Integrated file previewer for images, text, documents, and media
Smart path navigation with an interactive breadcrumb bar
Sidebar for quick access to home, documents, and other essential locations
Powerful search capabilities to find your data instantly
Full support for common file operations like rename, copy, cut, and paste
Rich set of keyboard shortcuts designed for power users
